capabilities.label: Real camera live preview
capabilities.verification: Open /approvals/devices.html on the target device, grant permission, confirm stream and actual resolution; export report.

capabilities.label: Local reels/video recording and playback
capabilities.verification: Record an authorized test clip, play it locally, verify supported format/resolution and synchronization.

capabilities.label: Owner review and approval queue
capabilities.verification: Run owner-token issuer and approval-store test; publishing remains a separate gate.

capabilities.label: Audio output routing and test tone
capabilities.verification: Send test tone and physically confirm selected output; verify OS route.

capabilities.label: Microphone permission and input meter
capabilities.verification: Grant permission, speak and confirm meter response; stop capture.

capabilities.label: Dolby processing/hardware/license
capabilities.verification: Do not infer from browser APIs. Change status only after authoritative OS/vendor/licence diagnostic and repeatable test.

note: Registry entries do not claim physical installation or production deployment. Each target device must pass tests.
